$comment: PowerPoint Live drawing-tool artwork, captured from the Teams DOM.
These are Microsoft's own illustrations - gradients, blur filters, blend
modes, inner shadows - not Fluent glyphs and not anything that can be
approximated with a monochrome path. Earlier attempts to redraw them, and
to substitute the flat 'Clay' icon set found in the Teams bundle, both
produced something visibly different from the toolbar.
Captured 2026-09-17 from a live presenter session with the snippet in
tools/capture-tool-icons.js, run in the Teams DevTools console. Re-capture
the same way if a Teams update changes them.
Two edits were made to what the DOM gave us, and nothing else:
- React's generated id prefixes (':rd:', ':re:' ...) were replaced with
stable per-tool prefixes, so several icons can coexist on one page
without their gradient and filter ids colliding.
- The tool's current ink colour was replaced with the token {ink}, so a
key can be drawn in whatever colour the tool is actually set to. The
hex each one used at capture time is recorded in 'capturedInk'.
Elements marked display='none' in the DOM were dropped; they are the
alternate states Teams keeps around but does not show.
